name: ax-commons
description: Local ledger for the ax-commons contribution loop: declare one intent, log AI tasks, report issues, and review consent. Everything stays on your device; nothing is transmitted.
long_description: AX Commons is an open contribution loop for public AI-adoption programs. This extension runs entirely on your device. It records your declared intent, task tags (type, human review, reuse), issue reports, and consent items in a single local SQLite ledger. Conversation text is never collected: every tool accepts only fixed categories, yes/no flags and an optional number of minutes, so there is no field text could be copied into. This version transmits nothing; the ledger can be exported to a readable JSON file or deleted at any time. Minimal aggregate measurement is part of the program terms and starts only with a later version; sharing contributions is a separate opt-in.

tools.name: declare_intent
tools.description: Record the one piece of work the user wants to change with AI, and why, as two fixed categories.

tools.name: log_task
tools.description: Record a completed AI task: type tag, human review, reuse, optional minutes.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Record a wrong or unhelpful AI result: error type and correction type.

tools.name: consent_status
tools.description: Show consent items, their scope and period, and the transmission history.
